english.notes:
Section 34 of the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 sets out the conditions, time limits and extensions in cases dealt with by summary proceedings. The time limit of six months does not commence until there comes to the knowledge of a responsible enforcing authority evidence sufficient in the opinion of that authority to justify a prosecution for that offence. See section 34 for the full detail.
Proceedings for an offence shall not, in England and Wales, be instituted except by an inspector or the Environment Agency or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

other.penalty:
Summary: In England and Wales 51 weeks imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale. In Scotland twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks should be read as a reference to 6 months.
